highlights_headline: The upcoming servicing release fixes Uno 6.x WebAssembly linking with the Skia renderer on .NET 9 and later.

bullets.lead: Compatible WebGPU linker flags for Uno
bullets.detail: Uno 6.x WebAssembly apps using the Skia renderer no longer receive the incompatible -sUSE_WEBGPU flag on .NET 9 and later, where Dawn's WebGPU port is linked. The flag remains enabled on .NET 8, which still uses Emscripten's built-in WebGPU port.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Fixed Uno WebAssembly linker flags for .NET 9 and later while preserving .NET 8 support.
